title: Mouse eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#a9b8cc'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='18' fill='#c4d1e0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='10' fill='#c4d1e0'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f2a8b8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='10' fill='#c4d1e0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f2a8b8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#eaf2ff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#eaf2ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='3' fill='#f27a9a'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='47' x2='42' y2='48' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='53' x2='42' y2='51' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='47' x2='58' y2='48' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='53' x2='58' y2='51' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- snack: yellow cheese wedge held at mouth -->
  <polygon points='50,60 66,55 66,68' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <polygon points='50,60 66,55 66,68' fill='#f5b92e' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='61' r='1.6' fill='#e09a1a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='65' r='1.3' fill='#e09a1a'/>
  <!-- paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='63' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#c4d1e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='64' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#c4d1e0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 74 C10 78, 12 92, 26 90' fill='none' stroke='#f2a8b8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
